statement: Ardra's ruling planet (Vimshottari dasha lord) is Rahu; its presiding deity is Rudra (the storm god), symbolized by a teardrop. It is traditionally associated with upheaval that clears the way for renewal, intensity that isn't comfortable but is transformative.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
